newsitem.title: USA: Ault cites higher margins for Q3 gain.
newsitem.headline: Ault cites higher margins for Q3 gain.

text.p: Ault Inc said Wednesday a shift in its product mix to higher-margin electronic products helped earnings in the third quarter ended March 2 more than double compared to year-ago results.
The company said net income in the period totaled $620,000, or $0.15 a share, up from $270,000, or $0.12, a year ago. Sales increased to $10.6 million from $9.0 million.
Ault said its gross margin climbed to 26.6 percent from 22.9 percent a year ago due also in part to its ability to leverage fixed costs over a growing sales base.
Ault makes external power conversion products.
Its shares closed down 1/4 Wednesday at 7-1/4.
